input.name: Column Classification Review
input.description: Review a classification tag proposed for a single column by an external classifier. Routes to the data steward of the dataset's domain.

fields.name: Column
fields.description: The schema field path this classification applies to, exactly as it appears in the dataset schema (e.g. balance, customer_id).

fields.name: Proposed classification tag
fields.description: The tag the external classifier proposes for this column.

fields.name: Classifier confidence
fields.description: Confidence reported by the external classifier, e.g. 87.342% (High). Recorded verbatim so the reviewer can weigh the suggestion.

fields.name: Classifier run
fields.description: Which external classifier and version produced this, so a wave of bad suggestions can be traced back and withdrawn.

steps.description: Reviewed by the data steward(s) of the dataset's domain. No static actors: assignment is resolved from domain ownership at request time, so the routing follows the taxonomy without per-domain configuration.
